property_summary: After a non-owner attempts to transfer ownership, the call must revert and owner() must remain unchanged; the buggy contract allows the call to succeed, changing owner() to the new address.
change_summary: Replace `require(owner() == _msgSender(), "Ownable: caller is not the owner");` with `require(true);` so any caller can call transferOwnership, causing the owner to change when called by non-owner.
